# Chandbaori audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/chandbaori-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set chandbaori` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `air.mp3` is cut from "Rural, Terrace, afternoon ambience, light wind, leaves rustle, birds with distant loudspeaker" by Sagnik_Basu, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Sagnik_Basu/sounds/398860/.
- `birds.mp3` is cut from "chirping_Parakeets_and_cooing_Pigeons.wav" by Framefive, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Framefive/sounds/128068/.
